patches.summary: Rewrite extractTSDRObject() to handle the live TSDR API's trademarks[] envelope and flatten nested status/parties sub-objects.
patches.reason: The generated code expected ST96 XML-derived envelope keys (TrademarkBag, trademarkBag) but the live API returns {"trademarks":[{"status":{...},"parties":{...}}]}. All fields are nested under status sub-object, requiring flattening for extractStringField to work.
patches.validated_outcome: trademark status 78787878 --json returns all fields populated (markText, status, owner, classes, etc.)

patches.summary: Update all extractStringField() lookups to use correct TSDR API field names as first keys.
patches.reason: The generated code used ST96 XML field names (MarkVerbalElementText, MarkCurrentStatusExternalDescriptionText, etc.) but the live API uses abbreviated names (markElement, extStatusDesc, statusDate, filingDate, etc.).

patches.summary: Add GetJSON client method that bypasses surf's Chrome impersonation for reliable JSON content negotiation.
patches.reason: The surf library's Impersonate().Chrome() overrides the Accept: application/json header, causing the TSDR API to return XML. All workflow commands switched from GetWithHeaders to GetJSON.

patches.summary: Detect HTTP 406 and XML responses from the /casedocs endpoint and display a clear message with TSDR web UI link.
patches.reason: The /casedocs/{caseid}/info endpoint only supports XML responses (returns HTTP 406 for Accept: application/json). Instead of empty output, the CLI now prints an informational message.

patches.summary: Rewrite parseBatchResponse() for the actual multi-status API structure: {transactionList:[{trademarks:[...]}]}.
patches.reason: The generated code expected a flat array or TrademarkBag wrapper. The live /caseMultiStatus endpoint wraps results in transactionList with per-transaction trademarks arrays.

patches.summary: Fix extractStringField to render float64 values as integer strings instead of scientific notation.
patches.reason: The TSDR API returns serialNumber as a JSON number (78787878), which Go parses as float64. fmt.Sprintf("%v") renders this as 7.8787878e+07. The fix detects whole-number floats and formats them as integers.

patches.summary: Add resourceIDFieldOverrides entry for the watch cache resource type.
patches.reason: Without the override, UpsertBatch could not find an ID field in tmWatchEntry (serialNumber doesn't match any generic fallback), causing all cached items to be silently dropped.

patches.summary: Disable sync/archive with clear messaging — TSDR has no JSON list endpoints.
patches.reason: The generated sync targets (/casedocs/bundle.xml, /casedocs/bundle.zip) return XML and ZIP binary which the JSON-only sync layer cannot process. Replaced with informational messages pointing to trademark watch/batch.
